Stanford University

Our Leadership

Stanford’s leaders work together to set strategic priorities, steward resources in support of research and education, and strengthen the capacity of students, faculty, and staff to innovate, collaborate, and contribute solutions for a changing world.

President Jonathan Levin

Jonathan Levin, a distinguished economist and former dean of the Graduate School of Business, serves as Stanford’s 13th president. Since he assumed the position in August 2024, Levin has articulated a vision of excellence, openness, and optimism. He has focused on strengthening Stanford’s culture of inquiry and advancing its research leadership in the era of data-driven discovery.

Office of the President Visit the Office of the President website to learn more about Stanford leadership.

Provost Jenny Martinez

Jenny Martinez, a leading expert on international law and constitutional law and former dean of Stanford Law School, serves as Stanford’s provost – the chief academic and budgetary officer of the university. She assumed the position in October 2023 and has placed special emphasis on championing academic freedom and cultivating civil discourse on campus.

Office of the Provost Visit the Office of the Provost website to learn more about Stanford Leadership.

Board of Trustees

The Board of Trustees, chaired by Lily Sarafan, ’03, is custodian of the endowment and all the properties of Stanford University.

Stanford University Board of Trustees Visit the Board of Trustees website to learn more about Stanford leadership.

Faculty Senate

The Faculty Senate is the legislative body of the Academic Council and has responsibility for academic and research policy as well as the authority to grant degrees.

Faculty Senate Visit the Faculty Senate website for more information about Stanford leadership.
